item.title: UT Board of Trustees Approves Melissa Tindell as Vice President for Communications and Marketing - The University of Tennessee System
item.description: KNOXVILLE — The Executive Committee of the University of Tennessee Board of Trustees today approved the appointment of Melissa Tindell as vice president for communications and marketing for the University of Tennessee System, effective retroactively on Jan. 1, 2026.

item.title: UT Extension Highlighted by Everywhere You Look, UT Mural in Bedford County - The University of Tennessee System
item.description: The 69th Everywhere You Look, UT mural, first of 2026, has been painted on the side of the Bedford County Extension office building.

item.title: UT President to Deliver 10th Annual State of the University Address - The University of Tennessee System
item.description: UT System President Randy Boyd will deliver the 10th annual State of the University Address at the Drury Plaza Hotel in Franklin.

item.title: PUBLIC NOTICE: UT Health Science Center Releases Proposed Tuition and Mandatory Fee Increases - The University of Tennessee System

item.title: Delivering on the Promise: UT Leaders Discuss Successes, Vision for 2030 During the State of the University - The University of Tennessee System
item.description: FRANKLIN, Tenn. — UT System President Randy Boyd opened the 10th annual State of the University with remarks and a panel discussion.

item.title: University of Tennessee System Awards $50,000 Grants to Six Universities to Expand Teacher Preparation Pathways - The University of Tennessee System
